subject: [PATCH v3 4/8] mm/page_alloc: pass the zone, not the zoneref, to reclaim_retry_zone

2026-10-21.patch_summary: This patch fixes a kernel NULL pointer dereference bug by passing the zone to the reclaim_retry_zone tracepoint instead of the zoneref. The bug occurs when offlining a zone's last block rebuilds the zonelists in place, causing the shrunk list's NULL terminator to land on the slot being read. The patch changes the tracepoint to use the already loaded zone from the loop, which fixes the issue and prevents kernel oopses.
